name: Ping Scope
summary: A city search with suggestions where matches ping on a radar and Enter locks on to show delivery
about: A delivery checker for a courier: type your city and the matching cities ping on a small radar laid out like the map of Pakistan, while the rest fade. The suggestion list highlights the letters you typed and the crosshair follows the highlighted city. Pick one and the beam swings onto it, locks on, draws the route from the hub and shows days, price and distance.
how: Type part of a city name; up to four matches appear with the typed letters marked
Use the Up and Down arrows (or hover) to move the crosshair between matches
Press Enter or click a city to lock on, draw the route from Lahore and see days, fee and distance
Try a name we do not cover to see the scope lose the signal; Escape or the cross clears it
